summary: Apache Parquet Java has advanced through its 1.18.2 release cycle, with RC0, RC1, and RC2 now available, each noting minor fixes and dependency updates. Meanwhile, the community is debating new features such as a FINITE_VECTOR type, clarifying the FILE logical type semantics, and evaluating compression schemes, with benchmarks favoring plain PFOR for decode throughput and compression ratio.

highlights.text: Apache Parquet Java released RC0, RC1, and RC2 for version 1.18.2, each detailing minor fixes and dependency updates.
Benchmark results show plain PFOR delivers the best decode throughput and compression ratio, recommending inclusion of PFOR-Delta.
